source_claim.locator: Nakshatra-prakarana, Dharma-kriya commencement in verse 30, printed pp. 40-41 (OCR lines 2685-2700 in the Internet Archive full text)
source_claim.scope: Supports the thirteen named Nakshatras; Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday; Budha- or Guru-ruled Lagna or Varga; Guru in Lagna; and adequate personal Guru-bala. Automation conservatively admits the four Budha/Guru-ruled Lagnas, while the Varga alternative, Guru occupation and personal Guru strength remain mandatory practitioner checks. The scope is beginning Dharma-kriya—religious or meritorious work—not every modern project, habit, relationship, relocation or life change. The former Amrit Choghadiya and Nanda-Tithi proxies have been removed because verse 30 does not supply them.

source_claim.locator: Nakshatra-prakarana, 'Pretakriya ka muhurta,' verse 48, printed pp. 47-48 (OCR lines 2956-2971 in the Internet Archive full text)
source_claim.scope: Implements the verse's nine-star positive admission list for Pretakriya that could not be performed at the time of death: Ashvini, Pushya, Hasta, Ashlesha, Moola, Jyeshtha, Shravana, Ardra and Swati. This narrower deferred-rite scope removes the former generic Antyeshti ranking and does not require approximating the separate four-and-a-half-Nakshatra cremation prohibition, because none of Dhanishtha, Shatabhisha, Purva Bhadrapada, Uttara Bhadrapada or Revati is admitted by the positive list. Immediate legal, medical and ritual duties override the finder; the profile must never be used to delay Antyeshti.

source_claim.locator: B. V. Raman, Chapter XII, 'Laying the Foundation,' roofing-stage instruction, inspected in the 2020 Chistabo derivative at internal printed p. 51 (physical PDF p. 55)
source_claim.scope: Supports only the configured Vrishabha-or-Tula rising-Rasi admission rule for roofing. The passage distinguishes roofing from foundation laying but supplies no separate weekday, Tithi or Nakshatra list for this stage. The Panchaka-Nakshatra restriction is a separately implemented project rule and does not inherit authority from this citation.

source_claim.locator: B. V. Raman, Chapter XIII, 'Felling Trees,' inspected in the 2020 Chistabo derivative at internal printed p. 58 (physical PDF p. 62)
source_claim.scope: Supports felling trees during Chandra's last quarter, represented by Krishna Ashtami through Amavasya, and the disclosed dry-Rasi/dry-Graha chart check. The Panchaka-Nakshatra restriction is a separately implemented project rule and does not inherit authority from this citation.

source_claim.locator: B. V. Raman, Chapter XVI, 'Electing Head of the State' and 'Coronation,' inspected in the 2020 Chistabo derivative at internal printed p. 66 (physical PDF p. 70)
source_claim.scope: The coronation paragraph explicitly applies the immediately preceding head-of-state rules. This supports the configured Nakshatra, exact Tithi and admitted rising-Rasi lists plus the disclosed election-chart checks and the traditional-coronation and democratic-government alternatives. Shared samskara exclusions and the Urdhva-Mukha preference are separately implemented project rules and do not inherit authority from this citation.
